fingerprint_algorithm: For each file, sorted by POSIX relative path: sha256(relative_path UTF-8, NUL, decimal size, NUL, sha256(file bytes)). Candidate and subtree aggregates sort the same way; directory aggregates are not used.

write_policy.archive_read_only: Existing official files under output_compare are verifiable reference material: never overwrite, never delete, never rerun a query to replace them, and never copy them into a computation input.
write_policy.new_downloads: New official page downloads (result lists) go into the registered webpage_info/<parent>/ page archive using the documented naming; new official exports may only be written into Method2/<K>/nmod<N>/ folders that were generated from a parsed official result list. Unknown lists stay blank until downloaded; no local-web-version output may be used to infer them.
write_policy.reuse: Before every download, look the query up in this registry and in the webpage_info page index. A registered candidate set or already archived official page is reused by reference; it is not downloaded again and not copied into a computation input.
write_policy.fingerprints: An audit re-fingerprints the archive and fails closed if a registered subtree or candidate aggregate changes.
